mapper.insert: INSERT INTO archive_access_application (application_no, applicant_id, department_id, purpose, use_type, start_at, due_at, status, version_no, created_at) VALUES (#{applicationNo}, #{applicantId}, #{departmentId}, #{purpose}, #{useType}, #{startAt}, #{dueAt}, #{status}, #{versionNo}, #{createdAt})
INSERT INTO archive_access_item (application_id, archive_version_id, employee_id, department_id, status) VALUES (#{applicationId}, #{versionId}, #{employeeId}, #{departmentId}, #{status})
mapper.select: SELECT id, application_id, archive_version_id, employee_id, department_id, status FROM archive_access_item WHERE application_id = #{applicationId} ORDER BY id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO archive_use_record (application_id, operator_id, used_at, returned_at, return_status, remark) VALUES (#{applicationId}, #{operatorId}, #{usedAt}, #{returnedAt}, #{returnStatus}, #{remark})
mapper.select: SELECT id, application_id, operator_id, used_at, returned_at, return_status, remark FROM archive_use_record WHERE application_id = #{applicationId} AND returned_at IS NULL ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 1
